basic_info.description: Fantastic SF living ideally located perched near the top of and across from Dolores Park, with desirable downtown views, #1 is a chic one-bed, one-bath residence with windows in every room in a classic SF 6-unit building. Spacious foyer with deep walk-in closet and intercom flows into the corner living room with stunning five-lite bay window providing downtown views and natural light plus stunning tray/coved ceiling, and refinished hardwood floors. The large chef's kitchen offers new stainless, Bosch appliance suite, deep sink, and commercial style pre-rinse faucet. Generous refinished butcher-block countertops, and open shelving. Spacious bedroom with tall walk-in closet, large bay window with tree-top outlooks, hardwood floors. Private office nook with built-in shelves doubles as walk-in closet. Bright, tiled bathroom with new vanity with faucet, large soaking tub with shower, and open shelving. Rear laundry room with new Electrolux machines, large window, and space for laundry necessities and additional storage. New lighting throughout. Prime location across from Dolores Park offering amazing views of SF, tennis, playground, and picnic benches. A plethora of shopping and dinning amenities close by including Tartine Bakery, Bi-Rite, and Whole Foods. SF city living at its best.
